en.home.about.title: Wu Qin Research Laboratory
en.home.about.p1: Our lab focuses on precision oncology and has established an integrated research framework of “technology development – mechanistic investigation – clinical translation.”
en.home.about.p2: By developing high-performance molecular probes and integrating cutting-edge technologies such as single-cell sequencing and spatial proteomics, the group builds intelligent multi-omics data analysis models to systematically map the spatiotemporal dynamics of tumor initiation and progression.
en.home.about.p3: The ultimate goal is to develop novel targeted therapeutic strategies and companion diagnostic biomarkers, thereby enabling personalized precision treatment.

zh.home.about.title: 吴芩课题组
zh.home.about.p1: 课题组聚焦精准肿瘤学，建立了“技术开发—机制研究—临床转化”一体化研究框架。
zh.home.about.p2: 通过开发高性能分子探针，并结合单细胞测序、空间蛋白组学等前沿技术，团队构建智能多组学数据分析模型，系统描绘肿瘤发生发展的时空动态分子图谱。
zh.home.about.p3: 最终目标是发展新的靶向治疗策略和伴随诊断生物标志物，从而推动个体化精准治疗。
